I build reproducible data pipelines and turn messy institutional data into
decisions people can act on. Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at
**Willamette University**, where my capstone [shows the university libraries
which e-resources their community actually uses](capstone.qmd) so librarians can
renew and retire journal packages without quietly cutting off small departments.

I care about equitable access to information, reproducible workflows, and
explaining an analysis to the person who has to defend the decision it informs.

**Currently looking for** data analyst, data scientist, and geospatial analyst
roles starting September 2026. Open to relocation. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or
grab my [resume](resume.qmd).
